title: Unique email and KYC gating
text: An account can only be created with a unique email address. An account may not send or receive money until its KYC status is verified.
acceptance_criteria: Duplicate email is rejected.
Any money movement on an unverified account is rejected.

title: Deposit amount limits
text: A deposit amount must be greater than 0 and at most 50,000.00 per transaction.
acceptance_criteria: Deposits of 0 are rejected.
Negative deposit amounts are rejected.
A deposit of 50,000.01 is rejected.
A deposit of 50,000.00 is accepted.

title: Withdrawal floor — no negative balance
text: A withdrawal must never make the account balance negative.
acceptance_criteria: Withdrawing more than the balance is rejected.
The balance is unchanged after a rejected withdrawal.

title: Atomic transfers
text: A transfer between two accounts is atomic: either both the debit and the credit happen, or neither does.
acceptance_criteria: If the credit fails, the debit is rolled back.

title: Large-transfer pending approval threshold
text: A transfer of 5,000.00 or more must be held as pending_approval until a second, different user approves it. (v1.0 threshold was 10,000.00.)
acceptance_criteria: A transfer of 5,000.00 is held as pending_approval, not completed immediately.
The initiator cannot approve their own transfer.

title: Audit log for every money movement
text: Every money movement (deposit, withdrawal, transfer, approval) writes an audit log entry containing actor, action, amount, account(s) and UTC timestamp. Audit entries cannot be edited.
acceptance_criteria: Each money-movement operation adds exactly one audit log entry.
No update endpoint exists for audit entries.

title: Account lockout after failed PIN attempts
text: An account is locked after 5 consecutive failed PIN attempts. A locked account cannot move money.
acceptance_criteria: The 5th wrong PIN locks the account.
A correct PIN entered before the 5th failure resets the counter.

title: Exact decimal arithmetic
text: All monetary values are stored and calculated as exact decimals (never floating point) and returned with exactly 2 decimal places.
acceptance_criteria: 0.10 + 0.20 equals 0.30 exactly.
The API returns monetary values formatted as strings with exactly 2 decimal places (e.g. "0.30").

title: Daily outgoing transfer cap
text: Total outgoing transfers per account must not exceed 20,000.00 per UTC calendar day.
acceptance_criteria: A transfer that would take the day's total outgoing above 20,000.00 is rejected.

title: Sanctions list blocking
text: Transfers to an account whose country code is on the sanctions list (KP, IR, SY, CU) are blocked and logged.
acceptance_criteria: A transfer to a sanctioned country is rejected with reason "sanctions".
An audit entry is written for the blocked transfer.

title: Masked account numbers in statements
text: Account statements must mask account numbers, showing only the last 4 digits (e.g. ****1234).
acceptance_criteria: No full account number appears in any statement response.
Account numbers in statements are masked, showing only the last 4 digits.

title: Audit log retention — no deletion
text: Audit log entries must never be deleted through the API (7-year retention).
acceptance_criteria: No delete endpoint exists for audit entries.
A DELETE request to audit entries returns HTTP 405 or 404.
